# 📚 CRM PRO — MASTER API ENDPOINTS SPECIFICATION & MODULE CATALOG

> **Specification Version:** `2.0.0-PROD`  
> **Base URL (Production):** `https://api.crmpro.com/api/v1`  
> **Base URL (Development):** `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`  
> **Architecture Standard:** Zero Hardcoding Enum-First, Multi-Tenant Data Isolation, AES-256-GCM Encrypted  
> **Asynchronous Queue Engine:** BullMQ on Redis 7+  
> **Total Documented Modules:** **57 Modules**  
> **Total Documented Endpoints:** **412 Endpoints** (#1 to #412 strictly sequential)  
> **Last Synchronized:** 2026-09-26  

---

## 🏛️ EXECUTIVE API ARCHITECTURE & INTEGRATION STANDARDS

### 1. Universal Request & Response Protocol

All CRM Pro endpoints communicate strictly over HTTPS using JSON as the data exchange format. Every API request and response adheres to our strict **JSend-compliant Universal Envelope**.

#### Universal Request Headers

| Header Name | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-------------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `Authorization` | `string` | Conditional | `Bearer <accessToken>` required for all authenticated endpoints | `Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5...` |
| `Content-Type` | `string` | Yes | Media type for request body | `application/json` (or `multipart/form-data`) |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | `string` | Conditional | Explicit tenant scope override for multi-tenant context | `ten_65f29d18e8a91a001e3b8001` |
| `X-Request-ID` | `string` | Recommended | Unique client-generated UUID for distributed request tracing | `req_c893fab9-db54-4009-bacc` |

#### Universal Success Response Envelope

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Resource retrieved or operation completed successfully",
  "data": { ... },
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20,
    "total": 142,
    "totalPages": 8
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-09-26T21:55:00.000Z"
}
```

#### Universal Error Response Envelope

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE_ENUM",
    "message": "Human-readable diagnostic description",
    "details": [
      {
        "field": "fieldName",
        "issue": "Specific validation failure rule"
      }
    ]
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-09-26T21:55:00.000Z"
}
```

### 2. Multi-Tenant Isolation & Zero Hardcoding

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Multi-Tenant Security Invariant:** Every query executed against tenant-scoped entities automatically injects `{ tenantId: req.user.tenantId }`. Cross-tenant data leakage is cryptographically and logically prohibited.
> 
> **Zero Hardcoding Invariant:** All HTTP status codes (`HTTP_STATUS`), role names (`ROLE`), module identifiers (`MODULE`), permission verbs (`PERMISSION`), audit actions (`AUDIT_ACTION`), and error codes (`ERROR_CODE`) must strictly import from `server/src/enums/`.

## Module 1: 🔐 Authentication & Pluggable OAuth

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Identity & Access Management`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/auth`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts, oauth.controller.ts, mfa.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/auth/routes/auth.routes.ts, mfa.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `User, Tenant, OAuthState`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `AUTH_TIER (5 req/15 min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `GLOBAL`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 1 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/register` | Register new tenant & admin user | Public | None |
| 2 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/login` | Login with email & password | Public | None |
| 3 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/refresh` | Refresh access token using refresh token | Public | None |
| 4 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/logout` | Logout single session & invalidate refresh token | ✅ | All |
| 5 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/logout-all` | Logout all active sessions across all devices | ✅ | All |
| 6 | `GET` | `/api/v1/auth/me` | Get current user profile & tenant info | ✅ | All |
| 7 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/auth/me` | Update current user profile (name, avatar, phone) | ✅ | All |
| 8 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/change-password` | Update current user password with old password verification | ✅ | All |
| 9 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/forgot-password` | Request password reset email | Public | None |
| 10 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/reset-password` | Reset password using reset token | Public | None |
| 11 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/verify-email` | Verify email address using token | Public | None |
| 12 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/resend-verification` | Resend verification email to user | ✅ | All |
| 13 | `GET` | `/api/v1/auth/sessions` | List active sessions/devices for current user | ✅ | All |
| 14 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/auth/sessions/:sessionId` | Revoke a specific active session | ✅ | All |
| 15 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/auth/sessions/other` | Revoke all other active sessions except current | ✅ | All |
| 16 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/mfa/setup` | Generate TOTP secret & QR code for MFA setup | ✅ | All |
| 17 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify` | Verify TOTP code and enable MFA on account | ✅ | All |
| 18 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/mfa/disable` | Disable MFA using current TOTP code or password | ✅ | All |
| 19 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/mfa/backup-codes` | Generate fresh emergency backup recovery codes | ✅ | All |
| 20 | `GET` | `/api/v1/auth/oauth/:provider` | Initiate OAuth login/signup (Google, GitHub, Microsoft) | Public | None |
| 21 | `GET` | `/api/v1/auth/oauth/:provider/callback` | Handle OAuth provider redirect callback | Public | None |
| 22 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/oauth/:provider/token` | Direct OAuth token exchange (mobile app / SPA idToken) | Public | None |
| 23 | `POST` | `/api/v1/auth/oauth/:provider/link` | Link third-party OAuth account to authenticated user | ✅ | All |
| 24 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/auth/oauth/:provider/unlink` | Unlink third-party OAuth account from user | ✅ | All |

### 🔍 Endpoint Detailed Specifications

#### Endpoint #1: `POST` `/api/v1/auth/register`

**Description & Business Purpose:**  
Register new tenant & admin user. Handled by `server/src/auth/controllers/auth.controller.ts`.

**Access Control & RBAC Matrix:**

| Requirement | Policy Specification |
|-------------|----------------------|
| **Authentication** | `Public (No Token)` |
| **Permitted Roles** | `None` |
| **Required Permission** | `PUBLIC_ACCESS` |
| **Data Scope** | `GLOBAL` |
| **Rate Limit Tier** | `AUTH_TIER (5 req/15 min)` |

**Request Headers:**

| Header Name | Required | Description | Value |
|-------------|----------|-------------|-------|
| `Content-Type` | Yes | Payload MIME type | `application/json` |
| `X-Request-ID` | No | Distributed tracing ID | `req_uuid_v4` |

**Request Body Specification (`application/json`):**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Validation Rule |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| `tenantName` | `string` | Yes | Company / Organization name | `min 2 chars` |
| `subdomain` | `string` | Yes | Unique URL slug (e.g. `acme`) | `alphanumeric, lowercase` |
| `adminEmail` | `string` | Yes | Root administrator email address | `valid email` |
| `adminPassword` | `string` | Yes | Secure password | `min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 symbol` |
| `adminFirstName` | `string` | Yes | Admin first name | `min 2 chars` |
| `adminLastName` | `string` | Yes | Admin last name | `min 2 chars` |
| `plan` | `string` | No | Initial subscription tier (`STARTER` | `GROWTH` | `ENTERPRISE`) | `default: `STARTER`` |

```json
{
  "tenantName": "Acme Innovations Ltd",
  "subdomain": "acme-innovations",
  "adminEmail": "ceo@acme-innovations.com",
  "adminPassword": "SuperSecretPassword123!",
  "adminFirstName": "Alex",
  "adminLastName": "Vance",
  "plan": "GROWTH"
}
```

**Success Response (`HTTP 201`):**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Authentication successful",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "usr_65f29d18e8a91a001e3b8a12",
      "email": "alex.vance@acme-innovations.com",
      "firstName": "Alex",
      "lastName": "Vance",
      "role": "SUPER_ADMIN",
      "isEmailVerified": true,
      "mfaEnabled": false
    },
    "tokens": {
      "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
      "refreshToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
      "expiresIn": 900
    },
    "tenant": {
      "id": "ten_65f29d18e8a91a001e3b8001",
      "name": "Acme Innovations Ltd",
      "subdomain": "acme-innovations",
      "plan": "GROWTH",
      "status": "ACTIVE"
    }
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-09-26T21:55:00.000Z"
}
```

**Error Scenarios & Status Codes:**

| HTTP Code | Error Code Enum | Trigger Condition |
|-----------|-----------------|-------------------|
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request payload fails Zod schema validation rules |
| `409` | `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` | Resource unique constraint collision (e.g. email, subdomain, slug) |
| `429` | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Request threshold exceeded for client IP/session under Redis rate limiter |
| `500` | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | Unhandled runtime exception encountered during execution |

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Validation failed for request to /api/v1/auth/register",
    "details": [
      {
        "field": "parameterName",
        "issue": "Invalid format or missing mandatory attribute"
      }
    ]
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-09-26T21:55:00.000Z"
}
```

## Module 2: 🏢 Tenants & Tenant Detail Sub-endpoints

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Multi-Tenant Infrastructure`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/tenants`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/tenant.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/tenant.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Tenant, User, Subscription, AuditLog`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `GLOBAL / TENANT_ISOLATED`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 25 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants` | List all tenants (paginated, search, filter) | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 26 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tenants` | Create new tenant (Onboarding Wizard) | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 27 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id` | Get tenant details & profile | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 28 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id` | Update tenant profile & settings | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 29 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id` | Soft delete / deactivate tenant | ✅ | product_owner |
| 30 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/switch` | Switch active tenant context | ✅ | All |
| 31 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/suspend` | Suspend tenant access and subscriptions | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 32 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/reactivate` | Reactivate suspended tenant | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 33 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/impersonate` | Support impersonation login as tenant admin | ✅ | product_owner |
| 34 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/users` | List all users belonging to tenant | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 35 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/invoices` | List billing invoices for specific tenant | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 36 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/audit-logs` | Get audit trail for specific tenant | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 37 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tenants/:id/usage` | Get detailed resource usage metrics for tenant | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |

## Module 3: 👥 Users & Team Management

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Team & Access Governance`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/users`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/user.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/user.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `User, Role`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 38 | `GET` | `/api/v1/users` | List users in tenant (paginated, filtered by role/status) | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 39 | `POST` | `/api/v1/users` | Invite / create new team member | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 40 | `GET` | `/api/v1/users/:id` | Get user details | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 41 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/users/:id` | Update user profile, department, contact info | ✅ | Self, admin+ |
| 42 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/users/:id` | Deactivate / remove user from tenant | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 43 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/users/:id/role` | Change user RBAC role | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 44 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/users/:id/status` | Activate / deactivate user account | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 45 | `POST` | `/api/v1/users/:id/resend-invite` | Resend invitation email to user | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 46 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/users/me/data` | GDPR right to be forgotten (permanent account deletion) | ✅ | All (own data) |
| 47 | `GET` | `/api/v1/users/me/export` | GDPR data portability export (download user data) | ✅ | All (own data) |

## Module 4: 🎯 Leads Management & Duplicate Prevention

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Core Sales Pipeline`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/leads`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/lead.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/lead.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Lead, Contact, Company, Deal, Activity, AuditLog`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 48 | `GET` | `/api/v1/leads` | List leads (paginated, filters, sort, search, scope) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 49 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads` | Create single lead | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 50 | `GET` | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Get lead details | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 51 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Update lead details | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 52 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/leads/:id` | Soft delete lead (moves to trash) | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 53 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/:id/convert` | Convert lead to Contact + Company + Deal | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 54 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/:id/enrich` | Enrich lead data via AI / external lookup | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 55 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/leads/:id/status` | Update lead qualification status | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 56 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/leads/:id/assign` | Assign lead to sales rep | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 57 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/bulk-delete` | Bulk soft delete leads | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 58 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/bulk-assign` | Bulk assign leads to sales rep | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 59 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/bulk-tag` | Bulk add or remove tags on leads | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 60 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/bulk-status` | Bulk update lead qualification status | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 61 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/import` | Bulk import leads from CSV/Excel | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 62 | `GET` | `/api/v1/leads/export` | Export leads to CSV/Excel | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 63 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/check-duplicates` | Real-time duplicate check (match email, phone, company) | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 64 | `GET` | `/api/v1/leads/duplicates` | Scan and list all duplicate lead groups | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 65 | `POST` | `/api/v1/leads/merge` | Merge duplicate leads into primary record | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |

## Module 5: 📇 Contacts Management & Timeline

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Customer Relationship Management`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/contacts`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/contact.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/contact.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Contact, Company, Deal, Activity`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 66 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts` | List contacts (paginated, filters, sort, search, scope) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 67 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts` | Create new contact | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 68 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id` | Get contact details + linked deals & timeline | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 69 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id` | Update contact information | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 70 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id` | Soft delete contact (moves to trash) | ✅ | Assigned rep, manager, admin+ |
| 71 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/bulk-delete` | Bulk soft delete contacts | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 72 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/bulk-assign` | Bulk assign contacts to sales rep | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 73 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/bulk-tag` | Bulk tag contacts | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 74 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/import` | Bulk import contacts from CSV/Excel | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 75 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/export` | Export contacts to CSV/Excel | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 76 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/check-duplicates` | Real-time duplicate check for contacts | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 77 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/duplicates` | Scan and list duplicate contact clusters | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 78 | `POST` | `/api/v1/contacts/merge` | Merge duplicate contacts into single record | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 79 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id/activities` | Get activity timeline for contact | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 80 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id/deals` | Get deals associated with contact | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 81 | `GET` | `/api/v1/contacts/:id/invoices` | Get invoices associated with contact | ✅ | All (scoped) |

## Module 6: 🏗️ Companies & Corporate Hierarchy

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `B2B Enterprise Hierarchy`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/companies`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/company.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/company.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Company, Contact, Deal`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 82 | `GET` | `/api/v1/companies` | List companies (paginated, search, industry, revenue) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 83 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies` | Create new company profile | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 84 | `GET` | `/api/v1/companies/:id` | Get company details + employees + active deals | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 85 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/companies/:id` | Update company information | ✅ | Account owner, admin+ |
| 86 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/companies/:id` | Soft delete company (moves to trash) | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 87 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/bulk-delete` | Bulk soft delete companies | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 88 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/bulk-assign` | Bulk assign companies to account manager | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 89 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/bulk-tag` | Bulk tag companies | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 90 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/import` | Bulk import companies from CSV/Excel | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 91 | `GET` | `/api/v1/companies/export` | Export companies to CSV/Excel | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 92 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/check-duplicates` | Check duplicate companies by name, domain, GST | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 93 | `POST` | `/api/v1/companies/merge` | Merge duplicate companies into master account | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 94 | `GET` | `/api/v1/companies/:id/hierarchy` | Get corporate hierarchy (parent/subsidiary tree) | ✅ | All (scoped) |

## Module 7: 💰 Deals & Pipeline Kanban

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Revenue & Deal Pipeline`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/deals`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/deal.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/deal.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Deal, Pipeline, Contact, Company, Activity`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 95 | `GET` | `/api/v1/deals` | List deals (filters: stage, value, owner, closeDate) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 96 | `POST` | `/api/v1/deals` | Create new deal | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 97 | `GET` | `/api/v1/deals/:id` | Get deal details + products + stage history | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 98 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/deals/:id` | Update deal amount, stage, expected close date | ✅ | Deal owner, manager, admin+ |
| 99 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/deals/:id` | Soft delete deal (moves to trash) | ✅ | Deal owner, admin+ |
| 100 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/deals/:id/stage` | Move deal to different pipeline stage | ✅ | Deal owner, manager, admin+ |
| 101 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/deals/:id/win` | Mark deal as Won with closed value | ✅ | Deal owner, manager, admin+ |
| 102 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/deals/:id/lose` | Mark deal as Lost with reason notes | ✅ | Deal owner, manager, admin+ |
| 103 | `GET` | `/api/v1/deals/pipeline` | Get Kanban pipeline view aggregated by stage | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 104 | `POST` | `/api/v1/deals/bulk-delete` | Bulk soft delete deals | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 105 | `POST` | `/api/v1/deals/bulk-assign` | Bulk assign deals to sales rep | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 106 | `POST` | `/api/v1/deals/bulk-stage` | Bulk move deals to pipeline stage | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 107 | `POST` | `/api/v1/deals/import` | Bulk import deals from CSV/Excel | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 108 | `GET` | `/api/v1/deals/export` | Export deals to CSV/Excel | ✅ | All (scoped) |

## Module 11: ✅ Tasks & Follow-ups

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Productivity & Follow-ups`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/tasks`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/task.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/task.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Task, User, Lead, Deal, Contact`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 133 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tasks` | List tasks (filters: status, priority, dueDate, assignee) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 134 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tasks` | Create task linked to lead/contact/deal | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 135 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tasks/:id` | Get task details | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 136 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/tasks/:id` | Update task details & deadline | ✅ | Assignee, creator, admin+ |
| 137 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/tasks/:id` | Soft delete task | ✅ | Assignee, creator, admin+ |
| 138 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/tasks/:id/complete` | Mark task as completed | ✅ | Assignee, admin+ |
| 139 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tasks/bulk-delete` | Bulk soft delete tasks | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 140 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tasks/bulk-assign` | Bulk reassign tasks | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 141 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tasks/export` | Export tasks to CSV/Excel | ✅ | All (scoped) |

## Module 12: 🎫 Helpdesk & Support Tickets

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Customer Support & SLA`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/tickets`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/ticket.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/ticket.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Ticket, Contact, User`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 142 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tickets` | List support tickets (filters: status, priority, agent, SLA) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 143 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tickets` | Create support ticket | ✅ | All |
| 144 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id` | Get ticket details + conversation thread messages | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 145 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id` | Update ticket metadata & priority | ✅ | Assigned agent, admin+ |
| 146 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id` | Soft delete ticket | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 147 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id/messages` | Post reply message / internal note on ticket | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 148 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id/status` | Update ticket lifecycle status | ✅ | Assigned agent, admin+ |
| 149 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id/assign` | Assign ticket to support agent or team | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |
| 150 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/tickets/:id/resolve` | Resolve ticket with resolution summary | ✅ | Assigned agent, admin+ |
| 151 | `GET` | `/api/v1/tickets/sla-breaches` | List tickets nearing or exceeding SLA response limits | ✅ | super_admin, admin, support_agent |
| 152 | `POST` | `/api/v1/tickets/bulk-delete` | Bulk delete tickets | ✅ | super_admin, admin |

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Time & Schedule Coordination`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/calendar`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/calendar.controller.ts`

- **Primary Models:** `CalendarEvent, User, Contact`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

| 179 | `POST` | `/api/v1/calendar/sync` | Trigger two-way sync with Google Calendar / Outlook | ✅ | All |

- **Category:** `Corporate Governance & Compliance`

| 180 | `GET` | `/api/v1/approvals` | List approval requests (pending / approved / rejected) | ✅ | All (scoped) |

| 187 | `GET` | `/api/v1/approvals/history` | Complete audit history of approval requests | ✅ | super_admin, admin, manager |

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Real-time Messaging & Alerts`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/notifications`

## Module 19: 📝 Contextual Notes & @Mentions

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Knowledge Sharing & Team Collaboration`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/notes`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/note.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/note.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Note, User`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT (OWN / TEAM / ALL)`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 201 | `GET` | `/api/v1/notes` | List notes for entity (by entityType + entityId) | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 202 | `POST` | `/api/v1/notes` | Create note with @mentions and attachments | ✅ | All except viewer |
| 203 | `GET` | `/api/v1/notes/:id` | Get note details | ✅ | All (scoped) |
| 204 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/notes/:id` | Update note content | ✅ | Creator, admin+ |
| 205 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/notes/:id` | Delete note | ✅ | Creator, admin+ |
| 206 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/notes/:id/pin` | Toggle pinned status of note on record timeline | ✅ | Creator, admin+ |

## Module 27: 🗑️ Trash Management & Auto-Purge

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Data Recovery & Lifecycle`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/trash`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/trash.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/trash.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Lead, Contact, Company, Deal, Task, Ticket`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 266 | `GET` | `/api/v1/trash` | List all soft-deleted records across modules | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 267 | `POST` | `/api/v1/trash/:module/:id/restore` | Restore soft-deleted record back to active module | ✅ | super_admin, admin |
| 268 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/trash/:module/:id` | Permanently delete record (purge from database) | ✅ | super_admin |
| 269 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/trash/empty` | Empty trash (permanently purge all soft-deleted records) | ✅ | super_admin |
| 270 | `GET` | `/api/v1/trash/settings` | Get trash retention settings (auto-purge days: 30/60/90) | ✅ | super_admin |
| 271 | `PUT` | `/api/v1/trash/settings` | Update trash auto-purge retention duration | ✅ | super_admin |

## Module 35: 🔐 Product Key / License Key Management

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Licensing & On-Premises Activation`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/product-keys`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/product-key.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/product-key.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `ProductKey, Tenant`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `GLOBAL`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 304 | `GET` | `/api/v1/product-keys` | List all generated product / license keys | ✅ | product_owner |
| 305 | `POST` | `/api/v1/product-keys` | Generate single product key | ✅ | product_owner |
| 306 | `POST` | `/api/v1/product-keys/bulk-generate` | Bulk generate batch of product keys | ✅ | product_owner |
| 307 | `GET` | `/api/v1/product-keys/:id` | Get product key details and activation history | ✅ | product_owner |
| 308 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/product-keys/:id/revoke` | Revoke product key | ✅ | product_owner |
| 309 | `PATCH` | `/api/v1/product-keys/:id/extend` | Extend validity duration of product key | ✅ | product_owner |
| 310 | `POST` | `/api/v1/product-keys/validate` | Validate product key eligibility | Public | None |
| 311 | `POST` | `/api/v1/product-keys/activate` | Activate product key for tenant | Public | None |

## Module 36: 💾 Backup & Disaster Recovery

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/backups`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/backup.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/backup.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Backup`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `STANDARD_TIER (100 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT / GLOBAL`

### 📋 Module Endpoints Summary

| # | Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth | Roles |
|---|--------|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| 312 | `GET` | `/api/v1/backups` | List database backup snapshots | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 313 | `POST` | `/api/v1/backups` | Trigger manual on-demand backup snapshot | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 314 | `GET` | `/api/v1/backups/:id` | Get backup details and checksum | ✅ | product_owner, super_admin |
| 315 | `POST` | `/api/v1/backups/:id/restore` | Restore tenant database state from backup | ✅ | product_owner |
| 316 | `DELETE` | `/api/v1/backups/:id` | Delete backup archive from S3 | ✅ | product_owner |
| 317 | `GET` | `/api/v1/backups/:id/download` | Generate presigned S3 download link for backup archive | ✅ | product_owner |

### 🔍 Endpoint Detailed Specifications

#### Endpoint #312: `GET` `/api/v1/backups`

**Description & Business Purpose:**

**Access Control & RBAC Matrix:**

|-------------|----------------------|
| **Authentication** | `Required (Bearer JWT)` |

## Module 45: 🤖 AI Insights & Copilot

### 📐 Module Architecture & Controller Mapping

- **Category:** `Predictive Intelligence & Generative AI`
- **Base URL:** `/api/v1/ai`
- **Controller File:** `server/src/controllers/ai.controller.ts`
- **Route File:** `server/src/routes/ai.routes.ts`
- **Primary Models:** `Lead, Deal, AICache`
- **Rate Limiting Tier:** `AI_TIER (20 req/min)`
- **Tenant Scope:** `TENANT`

| 356 | `GET` | `/api/v1/ai/suggestions` | Get AI-recommended next best actions across pipeline | ✅ | All (scoped) |
